name: Rho GTPase activating protein 33

function.text: ARHGAP33 is the approved symbol for Rho GTPase activating protein 33. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in GTPase activator activity; phosphatidylinositol binding; regulation of dendritic spine morphogenesis.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Pancreatic adenocarcinoma; Gastric adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: ARHGAP33 encodes Rho GTPase activating protein 33. Its functions include GTPase activator activity and phosphatidylinositol binding.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ARHGAP33 have been reported in gastric adenocarcinoma and pancreatic adenocarcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
